svg.title: Win32Bridge compatibility map
svg.desc: PE loader: Implemented PE32+ mapping and relocations; Implemented IAT, delay imports and forwarders; Implemented TLS and DLL lifecycle; Implemented x64 unwind registration; Implemented Per-process DLL search flags and explicit search directories; Partial DLL search parity; Implemented Section protections; Implemented Ordinal exports; Implemented API-set aliases; Partial Failed load rollback and unload ordering; Partial Cross-module exception unwinding; Planned Managed PE and CLR hosting; Planned x86/WOW64 guest execution (needs JIT). Kernel32: Implemented Guest process creation; Implemented Handle duplication and inheritance; Implemented Events, mutexes and timers; Implemented Named pipes; Implemented Overlapped I/O and IOCP; Implemented Byte-range locks; Implemented Open-handle identity across local file renames; Implemented SetFileInformationByHandle for EOF, local rename and delete disposition; Implemented File mappings and directory notifications; Implemented Guest environment and current directory; Implemented Process-local section handles, shared views and section handle inheritance; Implemented Selective handle inheritance through STARTUPINFOEX; Implemented Suspended process and thread creation with ResumeThread; Implemented Session-local process and thread lookup, Toolhelp snapshots and PSAPI module queries; Partial Process termination and suspension after execution starts; Partial Additional startup attributes and job objects; Partial Named kernel-object namespaces and inheritance; Partial Threadpool and alertable waits; Partial File metadata and reparse points; Planned File identity across aliases and overlay boundaries; Planned Case-only rename and atomic directory moves; Planned Memory-mapped coherency across independent views; Planned Windows service hosting. NTDLL: Implemented Native read and write; Implemented Native lock and unlock; Implemented Native I/O cancellation; Implemented NtSetInformationFile for position, EOF, rename and delete disposition; Implemented Ldr module loading, references, unloading and export lookup; Partial Native module lookup flags and additional Ldr entry points; Partial NT object manager namespace; Partial NT virtual memory and section semantics; Implemented Native process and thread open by client ID and resume after suspended creation; Partial NT file information classes; Partial Native process and thread information classes; Planned ALPC. USER32: Implemented Virtual HWNDs and message queues; Implemented Menus and accelerators; Implemented Dialog navigation; Partial Modal focus and reentrancy; Partial Painting and resize fidelity; Implemented Class atoms and extra bytes; Implemented Update regions and paint lifecycle; Partial Capture, activation and Z-order; Partial Keyboard layouts and dead keys; Partial Clipboard interoperability; Partial DPI and monitor behavior; Planned Raw Input coverage; Planned Full desktop/window-station semantics. GDI32: Implemented HDC state and transforms; Implemented Regions and clipping; Implemented Paths and curves; Implemented DirectWrite layout and text metrics; Partial DIB and raster-operation parity; Implemented AlphaBlend and TransparentBlt; Implemented World transforms and advanced clipping; Partial Glyph indices, shaping and font fallback; Partial Metafiles and palettes; Partial MaskBlt, PlgBlt and unusual DIB layouts; Planned Full ICM profile transforms. COMCTL32: Implemented Built-in control classes; Implemented Property sheets; Partial Owner/custom draw and notifications; Partial ListView and TreeView fidelity; Planned Accessibility coverage; Implemented Toolbar, Rebar, Tab and StatusBar; Implemented ListView and TreeView base classes; Partial Virtual ListView, groups and state images; Partial Label editing and drag notifications; Partial Tooltip callbacks and theme parts; Partial Date, link, IP and extended combo controls. COMDLG32 / Shell32: Implemented Virtual file picker; Implemented Shell properties verb; Implemented Shortcut discovery and PE icons; Partial File-dialog behavior; Planned Printing beyond stubs; Partial PIDLs and namespace enumeration; Partial ShellExecute and file associations; Partial Browse-for-folder, filters and validation; Planned Explorer namespace extensions; Planned Thumbnail and preview handlers; Planned Jump lists and taskbar COM integration. Registry / Advapi32: Implemented Virtual keys and values; Implemented Persistent machine and user hives; Planned REGF compatibility; Partial WOW64 views and registry notifications; Partial Security descriptors and access checks; Planned Registry transactions and recovery; Planned Service Control Manager and service lifecycle; Planned Event Log integration. PE resources / SxS: Implemented Resource directory lookup; Implemented Dialogs, menus and images; Implemented Manifests and activation contexts; Partial Guest assembly resolution; Planned Language fallback; Planned External WinSxS store; Implemented Group icons and cursors; Implemented Version resources and raw data; Partial MUI satellite lookup; Partial Manifest dependency and assembly policy coverage. CRT / C++: Implemented Startup, heap and stdio; Implemented Formatting and scanning; Partial x64 C++ exceptions and RTTI; Partial Locale and multibyte edge cases; Planned Broader dynamic MSVCP/STL; Implemented Aligned allocation and descriptor redirection; Implemented Formatted input and output; Partial C++ exception pointers and cross-DLL ABI; Partial CRT locale data and restartable conversions; Partial CRT process creation and child stdio; Planned Further STL runtime versions and debug CRT coverage. Console: Implemented Guest screen buffers and input; Implemented Shell Terminal frontend; Implemented Standard stream redirection; Partial Console code-page fidelity; Implemented Input records and console buffers; Partial Control events and process groups; Partial VT input and output sequences; Planned ConPTY guest contracts and multiple attached processes. D3D11 / DXGI: Implemented Windowed presentation and resize; Implemented Presentation handoff after the first GPU frame; Implemented Immediate and deferred context identity; Implemented Buffer, texture and rendering-view identity; Implemented DXGI surface identity and subresource lookup; Implemented D3D11 texture sharing by NT handle and keyed mutexes; Implemented EnqueueSetEvent and Flush1 completion via guest events; Partial D3D11On12 and video interoperability; Partial Shared fences, named texture opens and access rights; Planned Fullscreen-exclusive presentation; Partial Adapter notifications and frame latency handles; Partial Host color-space and HDR forwarding; Planned Multiple and child-window swap chains; Planned Guest tearing and per-output HDR policy; Planned Full DXGI output and monitor contracts; Planned Direct2D and WinRT surface interoperability. D3D12: Implemented Windowed swap chains and queues; Partial Shared fences and handles; Partial Device factory and host SDK selection; Partial Device-loss fallback and recovery validation; Partial Fence waits backed by guest events; Partial Agility SDK version and path selection; Partial Device identity through queues and fences, with other device children pending; Planned Residency and multi-adapter validation; Planned D3D12 debug, tooling and capture interoperability. Networking: Planned Winsock coverage; Planned HTTP and higher-level internet APIs; Planned DNS and adapter enumeration; Planned TLS and proxy integration; Planned HTTP cancellation and async completion; Planned WebSocket and network change notifications. OLE32 / COM: Partial Apartment initialization and activation; Partial In-proc class factories and COM identity; Partial IStream and structured storage; Planned Cross-apartment marshaling and GIT; Planned Out-of-process activation and RPC; Planned Running Object Table and monikers. OLEAUT32: Partial BSTR, VARIANT and SAFEARRAY operations; Partial IDispatch and type metadata; Planned Type library registration and lookup; Planned Automation marshaling and coercion parity. COM drag and drop: Partial Clipboard data transfer; Planned IDataObject formats and advisory connections; Planned IDropSource/IDropTarget lifecycle; Planned Virtual files and shell drag/drop. IMM32 / TSF: Partial IMM32 startup stubs; Planned IME composition and candidate windows; Planned Text Services Framework text stores; Planned CJK input and reconversion. Accessibility: Planned MSAA object providers; Planned UI Automation providers and events; Planned Focus navigation and screen-reader integration; Planned Accessible common controls. UxTheme / DWM: Partial Common Controls activation and theme selection; Planned Theme classes, parts and state metrics; Planned Composition attributes, thumbnails and blur; Planned High-contrast and theme notifications. Input devices: Implemented Host keyboard and pointer translation; Partial Gamepad-to-guest interaction; Planned DirectInput device enumeration; Planned XInput state and vibration coverage; Planned HID and device arrival lifecycle. Windows Imaging: Partial WIC codec and bitmap adapters; Planned Metadata and color-profile coverage; Planned Additional encoders and stream contracts. Direct2D / DirectWrite: Implemented Internal DirectWrite-backed text; Partial Guest-facing factory and object contracts; Planned Direct2D render targets and effects; Planned DirectComposition visual trees. Legacy graphics: Planned DirectDraw surfaces and blits; Planned Direct3D 8/9 presentation; Planned OpenGL/WGL contexts and pixel formats; Planned Vulkan loader and presentation interop. Audio: Planned MMDevice and WASAPI streams; Planned WinMM wave and MIDI APIs; Planned XAudio2 engines and voices; Planned DirectSound buffers and capture. Media: Planned Media Foundation source readers and sinks; Planned DirectShow filter graphs; Planned Audio/video decoding and presentation; Planned Capture devices and streaming. Crypto / Trust: Implemented Native random generation path; Partial BCrypt and legacy provider coverage; Partial Certificate stores and decoding; Planned Chain building and trust policy; Planned DPAPI and NCrypt key storage. Security / Tokens: Partial Virtual access tokens and queries; Planned SID/ACL enforcement across objects; Planned Impersonation and privileges; Planned Credential Manager and SSPI. MSI / SetupAPI: Planned MSI engine, product and component registration; Planned Installer repair and rollback; Planned Device and driver enumeration; Planned INF and device-install semantics. Printing: Partial Print dialog stubs; Planned Print queues and spooler; Planned GDI and XPS print jobs; Planned Printer enumeration and configuration. RPC / Services: Planned RPC runtime and bindings; Planned Service discovery and control; Planned Task Scheduler; Planned WMI queries and providers. Database / Data access: Planned ODBC manager and driver registration; Planned OLE DB providers; Planned Cross-process data access integration. System integration: Planned WTS sessions and power notifications; Planned ETW and application diagnostics APIs; Planned Device notifications and removable media; Planned System-wide hooks and service integration. Web / Runtime hosting: Planned ActiveX and browser control hosting; Planned URLMon binding and protocol handlers; Planned Desktop WebView integration; Planned CLR hosting and managed runtime integration. Localization / NLS: Partial Code-page conversion and locale data; Partial Case mapping and collation coverage; Planned User locale overrides; Planned Per-thread UI language and MUI selection. Deployment validation: Partial Contract fixtures in source; Partial Representative guest-app workflows; Planned Repeatable Xbox regression matrix; Planned Published compatibility by build and app version
